enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Negative Energy Spike: This weapon is pulsating with negative energy. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of negative energy damage on a successful hit.
Lesser Vampirism: This weapon drains a tiny portion of the target's life force whenever it does damage.Note: provides 1 hp of healing per hit.
Nullification +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Void Lore IV: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Taint of Evil: Good aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.
Suppressed Power: This psionic item is powerful, but you sense that it has not unlocked all of its secrets to you at this time.

children.tooltip: Unholy Burst: An unholy weapon is imbued with unholy power. This power makes the weapon evil-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against all of good alignment and an extra 3 to 18 on a critical for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 4 to 24 for a x3 multiplier, and 5 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
Necromancy Focus II: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.

children.text: Becomes Bound to Character on Acquire
